notes.title: Monster Jam Showdown - Spike Unleashed
notes.content:
Get ready to let the dogs out, with #MonsterJamShowdown - Spike Unleashed! This DLC includes:
- Spike Unleashed with 2 liveries

notes.title: Monster Jam Showdown - Bad News Travels Fast
notes.content:
🚨 Breaking news! Bad News Travels Fast has arrived in #MonsterJamShowdown! Originally born in 1998, this legendary truck is ready to dominate the tracks.  
This DLC includes:
- Bad News Travels Fast with 2 liveries

notes.title: Monster Jam™ Showdown - Off The Leash
notes.content:
Unleash the chaos with the Off The Leash DLC! The #MonsterJamShowdown Dog House is open and the Monster Mutt™ pack is ready to rule the dirt! 
Which puppy will you take for a spin? 
This DLC includes
- Monster Mutt™ Retro with 3 liveries
- Monster Mutt™ Dalmatian with 3 liveries
- Monster Mutt™ Rottweiler with 3 liveries

notes.title: Monster Jam™ Showdown – YETI™
notes.content:
Feel the chill? ❄️ Yeti™ has stormed into #MonsterJamShowdown! 
This abominable snow truck is here to dominate the competition. 
Will you brave the cold and take it for a spin? This DLC includes:
- Yeti™ with 2 liveries

notes.title: NEW PATCH RELEASED
notes.content:
🚨 New patch alert! 🚗💥 
Improved collision damage in Survival Mode, fixed Showdown Tour HUD issues, and addressed bugs on various maps. 
Check here: https://monsterjamvideogame.com/new-patch-released-3/
